“It’s the only protection against the sun I possess,” was his reply, as, turning it over in his hands, his eyes lighted 164upon an inscription on the inside. He showed it to his companions, reading it aloud:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0068", "tag": "p", "text": "“DA VASCO.”", "sha256": "f71afe0b675bd167b0ad03cb601881915d44c4defc045da2b4ec3b0a6d51dbdd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1522]", "source_html": "

“DA VASCO.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0069", "tag": "p", "text": "“I have heard,” Leoncia breathed.", "sha256": "fa79a547da9ac1f2c9f264152268e471f1acaa636a23216560fee913c8d9886c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1523]", "source_html": "

“I have heard,” Leoncia breathed.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0070", "tag": "p", "text": "“And you heard right,” Torres nodded. “Da Vasco was my direct ancestor. My mother was a Da Vasco. He came over the Spanish Main with Cortez.”", "sha256": "16699623153a9b029b8ba5e68662422257bf04c3d48fa8f9ab193a65e202ba86", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1524]", "source_html": "

“And you heard right,” Torres nodded. “Da Vasco was my direct ancestor. My mother was a Da Vasco. He came over the Spanish Main with Cortez.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0071", "tag": "p", "text": "“He mutinied,” Leoncia took up the tale. “I remember it well from my father and from my Uncle Alfaro. With a dozen comrades he sought the Maya treasure. They led a sea-tribe of Caribs, a hundred strong including their women, as auxiliaries. Mendoza, under Cortez’s instructions, pursued; and his report, in the archives, so Uncle Alfaro told me, says that they were driven into the Valley of the Lost Souls where they were left to perish miserably.”", "sha256": "b28d2166c4e9271ffc38959701998262a75fab3f361d087c4cd4e9dbc74e20e6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1525]", "source_html": "

“He mutinied,” Leoncia took up the tale. “I remember it well from my father and from my Uncle Alfaro. With a dozen comrades he sought the Maya treasure. They led a sea-tribe of Caribs, a hundred strong including their women, as auxiliaries. Mendoza, under Cortez’s instructions, pursued; and his report, in the archives, so Uncle Alfaro told me, says that they were driven into the Valley of the Lost Souls where they were left to perish miserably.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0072", "tag": "p", "text": "“And he evidently tried to get out by the way we’ve just come in,” Torres continued, “and the Mayas caught him and made a mummy of him.”", "sha256": "5ca781cba3a4d81f79b88d759bbe9bbf6ed81ba18e8f52b7dcc778bc8fe33dc8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1526]", "source_html": "

“And he evidently tried to get out by the way we’ve just come in,” Torres continued, “and the Mayas caught him and made a mummy of him.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0073", "tag": "p", "text": "He jammed the ancient helmet down on his head, saying:", "sha256": "7964d4873eeb7434ca13c3731ce3031e513647148b19ecc9d181ea09468be66c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1527]", "source_html": "

He jammed the ancient helmet down on his head, saying:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0074", "tag": "p", "text": "“Low as the sun is in the afternoon sky, it bites my crown like acid.”", "sha256": "68763f5cd75e70bdf18f69adda4ae7a3bec688f4d2c79afd5ab7b7aa3afcf1cf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1528]", "source_html": "

“Low as the sun is in the afternoon sky, it bites my crown like acid.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0075", "tag": "p", "text": "“And famine bites at me like acid,” Francis confessed. “Is the valley inhabited?”", "sha256": "05b58a87005177cc5bda6c049c0ff27ce1480ddc637d730059b1313c92f97f50", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1529]", "source_html": "

“And famine bites at me like acid,” Francis confessed. “Is the valley inhabited?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0076", "tag": "p", "text": "“I should know, Senor,” Torres replied. “There is the narrative of Mendoza, in which he reported that Da Vasco and his party were left there ‘to perish miserably.’ This I do know: they were never seen again of men.”", "sha256": "5d3176657230ef91e68e2000baa23d99626f154d923658ca8793f04ca8e6a782", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1530]", "source_html": "

“I should know, Senor,” Torres replied. “There is the narrative of Mendoza, in which he reported that Da Vasco and his party were left there ‘to perish miserably.’ This I do know: they were never seen again of men.”

We’ve got enough troubles without having a very charming but very much poisoned young woman on our hands.”", "sha256": "762ca0ee58b194788df73fff3eb03902ae43eebda4623f00ca5ac1ee622e46a0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1531]", "source_html": "

“They’re all right,” she said, calmly eating. “You can see where the birds have been pecking and eating them.”
